name: Shokushu Makai no Ryoshuu ~Shippo Zeme to Kougyaku ni Kuppuku Shita Juujin Touzoku Yuni
original_name: 触手魔界の虜囚～尻尾責めと肛虐に屈服した獣人盗賊ユニ
source:
Long ago, the Kingdom of Lanrod was designated as the sealbearer
for the remains of the evil goddess Elixia, so that she may not be resurrected.
The malevolent one called Zodiac sought the final seal to resurrect her, but it was protected by five heroes in scattered fragments.
But after many months, the heroes now returned to Lanrod castle to reunite the fragments.
It was the perfect chance...

Enter Yuni, a thief girl with heightened senses. She felt Zodiac's evil and rushed to inform queen Ixia.

The seal's power was already beginning to fail.
Yuni felt a bitterness that could never be forgotten.
Just then, the tinge of evil again graced her senses.
"Mwahaha, I've got you at last."
"Ack! Zodiac!"
Yuni couldn't disguise her sudden terror, but she mustered every bit of courage she had.
"Take this!"
She lunged with animal swiftness, a throwing knife flung between his eyes as she unsheathed a secret dagger to eviscerate him below.
"Die!"
The knife froze in the air as though it has struck him, millimeters from his face.
His magic barrier had stopped it. No matter, that was enough - the knife had obscured his view long enough to stab him.
But as the low dagger was plunged into his side, in the floor below her magicked into an oilslick. She slipped, for just a brief second.
Enough to miss.
In the moment she took to regain her balance, the ground swelled in a horrific burst of roiling hot flesh as a tentacle spirit was summoned upon her.
"No! Oh god it feels so weird!"
"Mwahahaha. Ixia's cute little pet. I'll turn you into something pretty my own way..."

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE107303.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
很久以前，兰罗德王国被指定为邪恶女神艾莉克希亚残骸的封印守护者，以防止她复活。
被称为黄道的恶人寻找最后的封印来复活她，但封印被五位英雄以碎片形式分散保护着。
几个月后，英雄们回到了兰罗德城堡来重聚碎片。
这正是完美的机会……

尤尼登场，一个感官敏锐的盗贼女孩。她感受到了黄道的邪恶气息，急忙去告知伊克希亚女王。

封印的力量已经开始衰退。
尤尼感受到了一种永远无法忘却的苦涩。
就在这时，邪恶的气息再次触动了她的感官。
“嘿嘿嘿，我终于抓到你了。”
“啊！黄道！”
尤尼无法掩饰突如其来的恐惧，但她鼓起了所有的勇气。
“看招！”
她如野兽般迅猛地扑出，一把飞刀直刺对方双眼，同时拔出暗藏的匕首刺向他的下腹。
“去死吧！”
飞刀在空中凝固，仿佛刺中了他，距离他的脸只有几毫米。
他的魔法屏障挡住了它。没关系，这已经够了——飞刀遮挡了他的视线足够长的时间让她刺中他。
但当下方的匕首刺入他的侧腹时，她脚下的地板被施了魔法变成了油渍。她滑倒了，仅仅一秒钟。
足够让她失手。
在她恢复平衡的那一瞬间，地面以恐怖的方式隆起，翻滚的温热肉体中一只触手精灵被召唤出来压在她身上。
“不！天哪感觉好奇怪！”
“嘿嘿嘿。伊克希亚的可爱小宠物。我要用我自己的方式把你变成漂亮的东西……”
